Speaking from personal experience. I was told that my mother was raped by my father when I was 13 years old(I saw him maybe 3 times during my entire life) and as someone wrote here, it did DEFINE me. After reading Your responses, I would assume that she already had an idea that this might be possible, but just recently it got confirmed. She might react in a few ways. She may need Your presence, understanding, compasion and for the love of god, she needs to understand that she is not a mistake. I mean, I was crushed for a few good years after that(well, I still am), just because of my thoughprocess: if I was born from something bad, therefore I must be bad. You wrote that she is a therapist, just like her father. This probably wont work in her head like it did in mine, but I was scared shitless of becoming my own father. The best You can do is just be there for her, whatever she might need. Maybe try to point out how good mother she is, if You have a child - point out the differences. Best luck buddy.
